title: Le Repos (Rest)
collection: Musée d’Orsay, deposited at Musée des Beaux-Arts de Pau
description: An adult woman reclines on a cushioned bed with her arms behind her head. Boucher carved the marble in 1892; it entered the French national collection that year and has been deposited in Pau since 1978.
adult_art_context: Full-figure museum sculpture of an adult reclining female nude. Source visual shows mature adult proportions, a resting pose, and no sexual act, coercion, child, or animal. Suitable as historical sensual sculpture.
